title: Far runtime-index fold leaves an undef DBG_VALUE that fails machine verification
summary: When tryFarRuntimeIndexFold folds every non-debug use of a far pointer add into a [dp],Y access, salvageDebugInfo cannot express base + zext(offset) and leaves the DBG_VALUE naming the dead vreg. DetectDeadLanes marks it undef and -verify-machineinstrs rejects the function. Without the verifier the location degrades to $noreg and the emitted code is unaffected. The byte fold (0061/patch 4) and the native word fold (0070) both fail downstream. Found by the independent review (finding B4) and reproduced on the downstream toolchain.

prior_work.source_assessment: Downstream tryFarRuntimeIndexFold erases the folded G_PTR_ADD after salvageDebugInfo with no fallback for an unsalvageable DBG_VALUE; the extracted patches 4 and 12 match.
prior_work.binary_assessment: Downstream release llc 9031686c exits 134 for both the byte and word probes; the extracted pre-0070 llc fails only the byte probe and the candidate both, matching the review.
prior_work.decision: No defect record, TODO item or lit test covers debug values across the far index fold; the existing far tests have no -g input. New canonical record.

baseline.working_directory: /home/will/llvm-mos-65816 (repository root). Captured in the wt/321-far-word-rebase worktree /home/will/llvm-mos-65816-nearproof, where build/far-review-defects/downstream holds hard links to the same frozen binaries.
baseline.failure_signature: Generic virtual register use cannot be undef

resolution.change: patches/llvm-mos/0002-321-accum16.patch: tryFarRuntimeIndexFold (MOSLegalizerInfo.cpp), after building the folded access, sets every DBG_VALUE of the far pointer add (and of constant-offset adds on it) to $noreg with MachineInstr::setDebugValueUndef() once no non-debug use remains. The fold code is shared by the byte fold and the 0070 word fold; 0070 is unchanged and still applies.
resolution.causal_explanation: When the last access folded, the pointer add kept only debug uses; salvageDebugInfo cannot express base + zext(offset), so the DBG_VALUE kept naming the dead vreg, which DetectDeadLanes marked undef and the verifier rejected. Dropping the location when the add dies leaves no debug use of an erased value.
resolution.trigger_check: The unchanged dbgbyte.ll runs through the candidate llc with the baseline configuration and exits 0; the word-fold dbg.ll also exits 0 (candidate-word-fold.log), and after the legalizer the "p" DBG_VALUE is $noreg (candidate-dbg-values.log).
regression_tests: llvm/test/CodeGen/MOS/far-index-fold-debug.ll (in 0002): -g byte and word folds under -verify-machineinstrs, checking the folded pointer's DBG_VALUE operand is $noreg
